critical_code_review_comments: StepDivision: If a generated problem has leading dividend digits smaller than divisor, those columns render as empty (no quotient digit). Intentional and documented, but UX could add a visual hint (e.g., faded 0 or arrow). Not a bug.
LongDiv.jsx always uses difficulty='medium' for generateStepDivision — no user-selectable step difficulty yet. Future enhancement.
StepDivision recordAnswer on wrong uses dividend/divisor as a/b with op='÷' — stats bucketing by divisor is consistent with existing recordAnswer logic. OK.
